sections.label: Animation & Visual Development
sections.intro: From self-directed animated shorts to full world-building, my animation practice is rooted in personal storytelling and emotional specificity. Each project begins with a question I haven't been able to let go of — and ends with a film that holds the answer.

projects.title: Keep Yourself Safe
projects.highlight: Selected & Screened — Annecy International Animation Film Festival 2025
projects.description: A self-directed 2D animated short exploring mental health and digital culture. Fully solo-produced from script to final sound.

projects.title: Dear Friend
projects.description: A period/gothic 2D animation short. Features a rich concept-to-final pipeline: rough character sketches → finished designs → environment art.

projects.title: Jasmine — Visual Development
projects.description: Character and environment concept art for an Indo-jazz fusion world built around the Jasmine multimedia concept album. Spans illustration, animation, comics, and music.

projects.title: A-Stray-Dog
projects.description: Stop-motion group project. Puppets and sets built from waste materials and scrap. Handled full post-production and prop design.

projects.title: Chase
projects.description: Storyboard exercise for a chase sequence spanning a bridge, motorbike, and boat — exploring kinetic pacing and spatial continuity.

sections.label: Illustration & Comics
sections.intro: My illustration practice moves between narrative comic-making, character design, and freelance commissions — always with an eye for storytelling that transcends medium. Whether for a campus of 33,000 or a single client, every mark has an intention.

projects.title: Internship Experience Comics
projects.description: 6+ part comic series depicting student internship experiences, deployed across a campus-wide engagement campaign.

projects.title: Campus Wellbeing Comic Planner
projects.highlight: Produced in 7 days · Audience of 33,000 students
projects.description: Multi-episode campus-wide comic planner series produced in 7 days for a student community of 33,000.

projects.title: Campus for All: Everyday Moments of Inclusion
projects.description: Comic illustrating accessibility and inclusion practices on campus — sign language interpreters, inclusive sports, accessible formats.

projects.title: They All Came Wearing Duct Tapes on Their Mouths
projects.description: Black-and-white narrative comic panel work exploring silence and suppression through bold graphic language.

projects.title: Character & Concept Art — Global Clients
projects.description: 50+ personalised character illustration and concept art commissions across 5 years, with consistent 5-star client satisfaction.

sections.label: Videography & Motion
sections.intro: Video is where all my disciplines converge — design, narrative, motion, and performance all in one frame. I'm as comfortable directing a product tutorial series as I am producing a documentary or motion graphics explainer.

projects.title: SOCRAT AI — Animated Explainer
projects.description: 3-minute animated explainer video communicating complex AI platform concepts using motion graphics and data visualisation, produced for a startup launch.

projects.title: VIPCOLOR — How-To Video Series
projects.description: 17+ produced, filmed, and edited tutorial and product videos for VIPColor Technologies' website and social media channels.

projects.title: Global Connect Fellowship — Documentary
projects.description: 4-minute documentary-style video for the Global Connect Fellowship Programme 2024, targeting an international digital audience. Additional event photography across 3 OIE events.

projects.title: Music District NTU ADM — Event Videos
projects.description: Valentine's performance opening teaser and event highlights reel for Music District NTU ADM.

sections.label: Graphic Design & Brand Collateral
sections.intro: Design is my sharpest client-facing tool — from fintech PR collateral to full brand systems, I work at the intersection of strategy and craft. Every piece is built to communicate clearly at a glance and hold up under scrutiny.

projects.title: Elevandi — PR & Marketing Collateral
projects.highlight: Point Zero Forum — International Fintech Event
projects.description: 10 marketing posters and visual collateral for external PR/communications, plus presentation assets for the Point Zero Forum (international fintech event).

projects.title: VIPCOLOR — Social Media Campaign
projects.description: 17 video and illustrated social media assets for the 'Color That Captivates / Labels That Sell' VIPCOLOR campaign. 3 marketing strategies incorporated into team content planning.

projects.title: Green Arrow — Mock Brand Identity
projects.description: Full mock brand system: logo lockups in 3 colourways, event poster ("Eco Future — Sustainability & Innovation Competition"), tote bag mockup, and calendar-style teaser ad.

projects.title: NTU FEST — Full Design Output
projects.description: Full design output — posters, social visuals, merchandise — for NTU FEST. Managed a design sub-committee.

projects.title: Music District NTU ADM — Social Assets
projects.description: Sunset Jams event poster, Makeout Drive Recap post, Melody of the Drowned Halloween recap, and drum-kit signup poster.

projects.title: Obesity — Information Visualisation
projects.description: Data-driven infographic translating WHO/World Obesity Federation statistics into a structured visual explainer. Bridges graphic design and marketing/data-viz skills.

sections.label: Music Production
sections.intro: Music is both process and output — I compose to understand my visual worlds better, and I build visual worlds to make my music feel lived-in. The Jasmine EP is the fullest expression of this loop: a jazz-fusion album inseparable from its art.

projects.title: Jasmine — Capstone Concept Album
projects.description: Original jazz-fusion EP directing the full project lifecycle for physical and streaming release. Tracks: 'Welcome to the Jasmine,' 'Home Pt. 1 & 2,' 'Night Time,' 'Kopi.'

projects.title: Short Film Score
projects.description: Original score composed for a friend's short film — an exercise in writing music that serves narrative without overpowering image.

projects.title: Original Tracks
projects.description: Standalone original compositions: 'Cloudy Days,' 'Club Got Boots,' and the instrumental demo 'Paradise.'

about.bio:
I'm Ann Mary Saji — a BFA Animation student at NTU's School of Art, Design & Media, graduating May 2026. Over the last five years, I've built a practice that refuses to stay in one lane: I animate, illustrate, shoot video, design brand systems, and compose music, often all within a single project. My work has screened at Annecy, reached audiences of 33,000 on campus, and shipped for clients from fintech firms to indie startups.

I'm multilingual, internationally minded, and deeply interested in what happens when disciplines stop being separate categories and start talking to each other. My capstone project, Jasmine, is the fullest expression of that — a jazz-fusion multimedia world spanning animation, illustration, comics, and original music.
